g.text: Development screening only; no clinical validation. Case-to-patient mapping unverified.
Lines: means of 3 fitted runs, not an ensemble. Bands: +/- sample SD across seeds (not confidence intervals).
Final epoch 50 fixed; no best-epoch selection. Dice: 224 x 224 letterbox valid pixels.
